title: Lightly Buttery Indian Vegetable Gulab Jamun
description: A buttery, crumbly, and cozy Indian dish featuring vegetable stock and marinated vegetables, made in an ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly style and formed into gulab jamun shapes.
instructions: In a large pan, heat the melted ghee over medium heat and saute the grated carrots and cauliflower florets until they are tender.
Add the diced potatoes to the pan and continue to cook until they are lightly browned.
In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, semolina, and salt.
Gradually add the vegetable stock to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it is smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls and shape each ball into a gulab jamun shape.
Heat the gulab jamun syrup in a large pan over medium heat and add the shaped dough balls to the syrup.
Cook the gulab jamun for 10 minutes on each side, or until they are lightly browned and cooked through.
Remove the gulab jamun from the syrup and place them on a serving plate.
Sprinkle the garam masala over the gulab jamun and serve warm.
